svg.title: Parallax: the eight-jewel certification
svg.desc: Plate two, Parallax: a certification dial with eight ruby jewels, one per check: it points, it matters, stable under eight perturbations, calibrated, a second reader, the notes testify, the report can't lie, a receipt. Hand A visits all eight and reaches 'Doctor, consider'. Hand B stops at the second jewel, the deletion test, and is withheld: the heatmap was decoration. About 42% of brain and 44% of skin findings pass the deletion test; the rest are withheld. A leakage audit found 71% of an external set were near-duplicates. Decision support only. Live, source public, hackathon team build.
